hazard: Feeds are wired at runtime (registry.mjs dynamic import of readers/<kind>.mjs from data/feeds.json); csv mixes DD/MM/YYYY and ISO dates plus a quoted comma; amateur.json mixed date formats; the radio-log reader (never calls parseDate, so a parseDate fix misses it) slices the UTC stamp and puts sightings on the wrong observatory day/month (UTC-5); ties keep feed then line order
prompt: In the comet-sightings app, add an exported function sightingsInMonth(year, month) to src/sightings.mjs (month is 1-12). It returns the comet names sighted in that month from every sighting the app records, earliest day first; sightings on the same day keep the order in which they are listed. A sighting belongs to the calendar day at the observatory, whose clock is fixed at UTC-5 all year round.
